xray: You keep ₹{net} out of ₹{gross}. Your real earning is ₹{hourly} per hour over {hours} hours (waiting time included).
flag_unknown: Unexplained deduction '{label}' of ₹{amt}. Ask support for a breakdown.
flag_total: Total deductions are {pct}% of your earnings.
trip: Fare ₹{fare}, {km} km. After fuel and wear you keep about ₹{net} (₹{hourly} per hour). Verdict: {verdict}.
safe: Safe to spend today: ₹{limit}. Left for today: ₹{left}. Fixed costs per month: ₹{fixed}. Savings per month: ₹{sav}.
safe_short: Your income does not cover your fixed costs. Try to cut expenses or add side income.
loan: You receive ₹{recv} and repay ₹{total}. Real yearly interest is about {pct}%. Risk: {risk}. Safer options: bank, SHG or PM MUDRA loan.
diary_saved: Saved in your wage diary: ₹{amt} due. This dated note can help as evidence.
unsure: I am not sure about this and do not want to guess. Please ask at your nearest CSC, call 14434 (e-Shram), or NALSA 15100 for legal help.
sos: SOS: call 112 now. Share your live location with someone you trust. Emergency 112 | Ambulance 108 | Women helpline 181 | Legal aid 15100 | Cyber fraud 1930
crisis: I am worried about your safety. Please contact a human now. Emergency 112 | Ambulance 108 | Women helpline 181 | Legal aid 15100 | Cyber fraud 1930. If you are in danger, move to a safe public place and share your live location with someone you trust.
secret: Never share your OTP, PIN, password or full Aadhaar with anyone, not even me. I have removed it from your message.
grievance_help: I can draft a polite complaint. Ladder: 1) platform support 2) grievance officer 3) labour department 4) consumer forum 5) free legal aid (NALSA 15100). Use the Help tab to write the letter.
ask_safe: Tell me your monthly income, rent, EMI and bills and I will give you a daily safe-to-spend number. Use the Money tab.
ask_loan: Tell me the loan amount, monthly EMI and months, for example: loan 10000 emi 1200 for 12 months.
ask_trip: Tell me the fare and distance, for example: trip fare 120 distance 8 km.
knowledge_hdr: Official information (shown in English - please confirm on the official portal):
shift: Best times to work: {w1} and {w2}. Demand is highest in the first slot.
tip_rain: Rain: orders usually rise in the evening. Ride slowly and keep your phone in a waterproof cover.
tip_heat: Heat alert: avoid 12:00-16:00, drink water every hour and rest in the shade.
tip_festival: Festival or event: demand is higher. Plan extra hours but keep time to rest.
incentive: {rem} more trips to earn the ₹{bonus} bonus. You need about {per_hr} trips per hour for the next {hours} hours.
incentive_done: Target reached! You earn the ₹{bonus} bonus. Check it in the app.
incentive_far: The target looks hard ({per_hr} trips per hour needed). Check if the bonus is worth the extra fuel and time.
fatigue_low: You look fine. Keep taking short breaks.
fatigue_med: You are getting tired. Take a 15-minute break and drink water before the next trip.
fatigue_high: High fatigue risk. Please stop and rest now. Tired driving causes accidents.
vault_expired: {doc} expired {days} days ago. Renew it now to avoid fines.
risk_interest: High interest or charges are mentioned. Calculate the real yearly rate before signing.
risk_penalty: There is a penalty or fine clause. Check how much and when it applies.
risk_terminate: Work can end without notice. Ask for the notice period and reasons in writing.
risk_deduct: Money can be deducted from your pay. Ask for exact amounts and reasons.
risk_nonrefund: Non-refundable payment. Do not pay before reading the full terms.
risk_advance: Advance or deposit. Get a receipt and a written refund policy.
risk_none: No obvious risky clause found, but read everything and ask someone you trust.
petition: We, {n} workers of {company}, report the issue '{issue}' in {city}. We request the Labour Department and the company to investigate and resolve it.
petition_wait: Only {n} report(s) so far. A petition needs at least 3 workers so that everyone stays anonymous.
ui_sub: Your saathi for money, safety and rights
ui_disc: Not legal, medical or financial advice. In danger call 112.
l_doc_text: Paste the text of the notice or contract
letter_note: This letter is in English so you can send it to the company. Ask a trusted person or a CSC to help you send it.
